items.description:
A remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Java 17 has prompted warnings for server admins, especially as Oracle released 11 new Java SE security updates on the same day. items.description: Google finds attackers using autonomous AI agents to automate exploits, steal AI access and scale intrusions, often sacrificing stealth for speed.
